movers.text: QB Baker Mayfield (foot) trending toward sitting out Sunday at Detroit; Jalon Daniels likely to start, per NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.
DE Aidan Hutchinson tore his right ACL in Munich and is out for the season. LB Jack Campbell (neck) remains on IR. Two front-seven starters out.
QB Geno Smith (left ankle): Monday tests showed no major injury; status for Sunday vs. the Chargers to be decided during the week. Cade Klubnik played the 2nd half in Week 10.
OL: OT Asim Richards (knee) out multiple weeks per Kellen Moore; OT Taliese Fuaga (knee) and C Erik McCoy (biceps) listed doubtful.
CB DaRon Bland suffered a high-ankle sprain vs. the 49ers and is sidelined going forward, per the team.

TB.text: QB Baker Mayfield (foot) trending toward sitting out Sunday at Detroit; Jalon Daniels likely to start, per NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.

DET.text: DE Aidan Hutchinson tore his right ACL in Munich and is out for the season. LB Jack Campbell (neck) remains on IR. Two front-seven starters out.

NYJ.text: QB Geno Smith (left ankle): Monday tests showed no major injury; status for Sunday vs. the Chargers to be decided during the week. Cade Klubnik played the 2nd half in Week 10.

NO.text: OL: OT Asim Richards (knee) out multiple weeks per Kellen Moore; OT Taliese Fuaga (knee) and C Erik McCoy (biceps) listed doubtful.

DAL.text: CB DaRon Bland suffered a high-ankle sprain vs. the 49ers and is sidelined going forward, per the team.
DAL.source: Dallas Cowboys | Official Site of the Dallas Cowboys

DAL.text: G Tyler Booker suffered a high-ankle sprain in the 46-40 loss to the 49ers; Dallas made an O-line roster move to cover.

HOU.text: LB Azeez Al-Shaair (groin), the team's top tackler, placed on IR; out at least 4 weeks, starting with Thursday vs. the Colts.
DE Danielle Hunter (hamstring) missed Week 10 and is listed questionable for Thursday vs. Indianapolis.
RB Woody Marks (concussion) listed doubtful; did not practice Tuesday.

IND.text: CB Sauce Gardner (calf) DNP Monday, questionable for Thursday at Houston; CB Charvarius Ward (shin) called uncertain by Shane Steichen.
OT: RT Jalen Travis (knee) listed doubtful; LT Bernhard Raimann entered concussion protocol in Week 10. Short week for Thursday's game.

MIN.text: WR Jordan Addison needs thumb surgery and is headed to short-term IR; expected to miss a few weeks, per Kevin O'Connell.
QB Kyler Murray (hamstring) remains out; Kirk Cousins started and won 30-10 at Green Bay in Week 10.

ARI.text: QB Gardner Minshew (torn UCL, throwing elbow) on IR, season-ending surgery planned. Carson Beck started the Week 10 loss to the Rams.

MIA.text: QB Malik Willis (groin/core) on IR; surgery still being evaluated. Kyle McCord started the Week 10 loss to the Colts.

PIT.text: G Mason McCormick (ankle) suffered a significant injury vs. the Bengals and is listed doubtful.
WR Michael Pittman Jr. (foot, IR), out since Week 4: Mike McCarthy is "hopeful" he returns this week.

TEN.text: WR Wan'Dale Robinson (ankle) placed on IR Tuesday; WR Xavier Restrepo promoted to the 53-man roster.
WR Carnell Tate (shoulder) missed 2 games; Robert Saleh is hopeful he returns in Week 11 vs. the Cowboys.
G Peter Skoronski (hamstring) placed on IR Saturday.
